projectDescription: A mood-based wellness web app that pairs users with curated Spotify playlists, breathing exercises, and live weather data based on how they're feeling.
keyFeatures: Emotion-based navigation with five moods: excited, proud, stressed, tired, upset
Spotify playlist integration fetching curated tracks per emotion via the Spotify Web API
Breathing exercise recommendations matched to each emotional state
Real-time local weather data via the OpenWeatherMap API using browser geolocation
User feedback form with persistence to a JSON server backend
React Router-based single-page application with dynamic emotion routes
publicApiSurface: GET /emotions/:name — dynamic route rendering the per-emotion page (Emotions component)
getValidToken() — retrieves a cached or fresh Spotify access token from localStorage
getSpotifyToken() — fetches a new Spotify client-credentials token
pageDataArray — array of emotion objects mapping mood names to Spotify playlist IDs and background images
exerciseArray — array of breathing exercise objects keyed by emotion
GET https://api.spotify.com/v1/playlists/:id/tracks — fetches tracks for an emotion playlist
GET https://api.openweathermap.org/data/2.5/weather — fetches local weather by geolocation
